Chalak bachaav sabse accha hamla hai.
Hansi nirasha ke khilaf sabse achha kavach hai.
Teekha mazak raja ke kapde utar deta hai.
Rooh kismat ke tarashe raaston par chalti hai.
Jeb munh mein rakhi tez talwar hai.
Dimaag ek aisi riyasat hai jahan parchhaiyon ka raaj hai.
Ahankar se bharne par aatma ki naav chhed ho jaati hai.
Teekhi jeebh sabse bade oak ped ko kaat ti hai.
Man hi insaan ka maap hai.
Man apani pinjara banata hai, phir rota hai.
Rooh chupchaap ladi ladaiyon ke zakhm pehnti hai.
Log satya khojte hain, par bhram ko apnate hain.
Sahi samay par mazak aatma ko nirasha se bachata hai.
Rooh mein aise toofani chhupe hain jo aankh nahi dekh sakti.
Gahra kuan sabse meetha paani de.
Buddhi zinda dimaag ki chamak hai.
Teekhe dimaag ko miyaan ki zarurat nahi.
Rooh tab sunti hai jab duniya shaant hoti hai.
Tabhi bolo jab chup rahna badatar ho.
Tohfe mein mile ghode ke daant nahi ginne chahiye.
Ahankaar kohre ka bana darpan hai.
Hansi un zakhmon ko bharti hai jahan loha nahi pahunchta.
Gyaani apane vichaaron mein khush rehta hai.
Sab kuch badal raha hai; kuch sthir nahi.
Motasa vijay se dubla-patla shanti behtar hai.
Ek teekha jawab ek dimaagi javelin hai.
Apani jeebh ko apani buddhi se aage mat jaane do.
Jo khud ki seva kare, uska maalik bura hota hai.
Chaand par mat bhoko.
Chalak lomdi chare se pehle jaal ki bu soonghti hai.
Shaanti se khaya gaya sadhan bhojan bhi tyohaar hai.
Hum agyanta ke shant samudra par chalte hain.
Insaan apane chunavon se pehchana jaaye.
Hum mahatvakanksha ki ret par kile banate hain.
Ek prasann swabhaav sabse accha samaan hai.
Buddhi tez vichar ki khubsurti hai.
Teekhi baat buddhi ki talwar hai.
Ek majboor insaan naye kshitij banata hai.
Jo toofaan se dare, wah kabhi antareep nahi dekhega.
Tark bhavnaon ke vidroh ko dabata hai.
Buddhi woh aag hai jo vicharak ko garmi deti hai.
Jeevan ek natak hai; apana kirdar achhe se nibhao.
Sabse chalak jaal banane wale ko hi pakad leta hai.
Hum taare napte hain, par andar rasta kho dete hain.
Har phool ko gandagi se ugna padta hai.
Log siddhanto ka pinjra banate hain, fir use azadi kehte hain.
Dimaag ek samrajya hai jo girne ka intezaar kar raha hai.
Ek chatur tippani sangmarmar ke smarak se zyada chalti hai.
